messages:
Alex Chen: Heads-up — new us-gov-west-1 account for a DoE pilot. Need p4d capacity (on-demand) and ENI quota bumped ASAP. Who can open/support the ticket?
Marisol Vega: I'll open the AWS case. We need justification and a monthly spend estimate. @Finance Bot can you provide baseline?
Finance Bot: Estimated baseline: 4 x p4d.24xlarge (on-demand/burst) = ~$140k/mo. Marked as 'customer-funded pilot'.
Marisol Vega: Case opened: 1198234567. Requested: increase Running On-Demand Standard (p4d.24xlarge) to 8, ENI quota to 500, VPCs per account to 50. Submitted with expedited flag and business-impact notes. :pray:
AWS Support: Thanks, case 1198234567 received. I've routed to the GovCloud GPU team. Initial ETA 72 hours for review. Assigning a TAM for escalation.
Jin Park: tagging compliance — any special paperwork for GovCloud SS? Need compliance contact to sign. @Tara Nguyen?
Tara Nguyen: On it — sending the ATO checklist to the DoE contact now. Also confirm whether this is a dedicated account or part of an org unit.
Alex Chen: Dedicated account. Also hit something in testing last night: scheduler failed allocating p4d due to ENI errors. Error snippet: ```Failed to attach ENI: LimitExceeded: The maximum number of network interfaces has been reached for instance```
Luis Ortega: I can repro locally. Cluster autoscaler tried to spin 3x p4d and hit instance-level ENI limit per AZ (default 100). We need both account-level and per-AZ increases.
AWS Support: Update on case 1198234567 — we've requested per-AZ ENI increases from 100 to 250. For p4d capacity, GovCloud availability is limited; we've placed a capacity hold and are requesting capacity planning. Will update in 24-48h. Case owner: aws-gov-tam@amazon.com
Marisol Vega: Thanks. Can we escalate to the enterprise TAM? This is time-sensitive: pilot kickoff next week. Please mark 'business critical' and provide phone escalation.
AWS Support: Escalation requested. New subcase 1198234567-1 created for expedited capacity checks. Phone escalation scheduled — expect a call in ~4 hours.
Alex Chen: Great. Also flagging cost approval — Finance has to sign off on burst capacity if we exceed baseline.
Finance Bot: Acknowledged. Pre-approval threshold set at $200k/mo. Any estimate above that requires VP sign-off.
Marisol Vega: Noted. I'll keep usage within baseline; if we need to overspend we'll ping @Maya (VP Finance).
AWS Support: Final note — if on-demand p4d capacity in GovCloud cannot be secured in time, recommended fallbacks are: 1) Dedicated Hosts in a compliant region, or 2) staged work on approved non-GovCloud region with data egress controls. We'll include migration plans in the case update.
Alex Chen: Thanks — please paste follow-ups here and update the case. I'll monitor and coordinate with infra on retries. :eyes:
